source: Extracted from merlin/frontend, gl-pros-flutter (incl. origin/master), pay-mfe and origin-shell.
idRule: Ids are globally unique and stable. Never rewrite an existing id. New rows created by a split get a new id derived from the parent, e.g. pw-analytics-report becomes pw-analytics-report-a, -b, -c.

ownership.structure: owned by the editor: label, depth, parent, order, kind, and node creation or deletion
ownership.content: owned by Claude: route, gating, summary, steps, content, actions, states, goesTo
ownership.rule: An import patch may only write content-owned fields on nodes whose id already exists, and may append new nodes. It must never reorder, re-parent, rename or delete.

purpose: This map exists to support the Origin-to-Pros migration. It is not a unified component catalog. Links between nodes carry a migration status, not a parity status, because Origin is being retired rather than maintained alongside Pros.

kinds.section: a navigation spine entry: sidebar item, tab, or shell route
kinds.page: a destination you can land on
kinds.flow: a collapsed multi-step journey; see steps
kinds.embedded: third-party UI we do not own, currently Stripe Connect components

equivalenceTypes.same: same thing, same shape. Should behave identically.
equivalenceTypes.different-shape: same job, structurally different. Note how it translates.
equivalenceTypes.deliberately-different: the divergence is correct. Give the reason. This is what stops the migration backlog being infinite.

migrationStatuses.not-assessed: nobody has decided anything yet. The default.
migrationStatuses.re-specified: re-expressed in Pros vocabulary, not built

nodeMigration.note: Optional, on any node. Absent means in scope and undecided. Present means the node needs a different reading than the default, and the tool should render it distinctly.

values.third-party: Not ours to build. Embedded Stripe Connect components. Ports as-is; only the surrounding chrome is design work.
values.out-of-scope: Deliberately never coming across. GoodLeap-internal staff tooling.
values.later-wave: Real, contractor-facing, and in scope eventually, but not part of this migration.
values.not-yet-real: Exists in Origin behind a flag or on mock data. Cannot be assessed or designed against until it is built for real.
